verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Angular as a full development platform with CLI-based workspace setup, upgrade guides for AngularJS→Angular migration, and various CLI tooling, but there is no mention of embedding Angular components into an existing non-Angular page (e.g., Angular Elements, custom elements, script-tag inclusion) or any story about starting with a small page fragment and scaling up. missing for 10: evidence of Angular Elements/custom-elements for partial-page embedding, guidance on adding Angular to an existing non-Angular site incrementally, and any hands-on account of scaling from a widget to a full app.
